# Security Policy

## Reporting Security Issues

We take the security of this project seriously. If you discover a vulnerability or security risk, please **do not open a public issue** on GitHub.

Instead, report it privately using **GitHub Security Advisories**:
1. Navigate to the **Security** tab of this repository.
2. Under "Security", select **Advisories**.
3. Click **Report a vulnerability** to submit a private report.

Please include:
- A detailed description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce or proof-of-concept (PoC).
- Potential impact and affected components.

We will review reports promptly and collaborate privately on disclosures and fixes.

## Upstream Attribution & Disclaimer

This repository is an AWS DevOps Portfolio implementation. The underlying sample microservices application code is inherited from [GoogleCloudPlatform/microservices-demo](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/microservices-demo), distributed under the **Apache-2.0 License**.

Infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, container configurations, and AWS deployment manifests are maintained specifically for this portfolio project.
